resources.string: This is Skriti Lite. It has no app blocking, so it never asks for the accessibility service.
Choose the apps that tempt you
A smaller version of a goal that still counts as a win on a hard day. It keeps your streak but counts less in the day\'s percentage.
A few minutes after a goal\'s time slot ends before it counts as missed.
After a miss, you can still do the minimum the same day to turn it into a smaller win.
One day a week that counts for or against nothing, for a day you could not do anything.
Something you choose to do the next day after a miss, written in the goal. You mark it done when it is finished.
Lifts every block for a while when you really need an app. Hold the button for 5 seconds on the block screen. Two uses a day.
Unlocks one blocked app for a few minutes after a wait and a typed reason. Off by default for each goal.
While a block is running, changes that would make it weaker only take effect after a delay, so a bad moment cannot undo a good decision.
The emergency unblock is on the block screen: hold the button for 5 seconds. It lifts every block for a while and can be used twice a day.
Day %1$d of %2$d. Keep logging; Skriti will not guess before then.
Let Skriti see which app is open

Skriti reads only the name of the app in front and the time, never what is on screen, and nothing leaves your phone. Without it, apps cannot be blocked or asked about. Switch Skriti on in the list that opens.
Android turned off Skriti\'s blocker, so apps are not being watched. Switch it on under Accessibility > Skriti.
For a trip or an illness
%1$s ended at the minimum on %2$d of the last 14 days. Consider lowering the target so it fits your real days.
%1$s hit the target %2$d days in a row. Consider raising the minimum or the target.
Time to back up your data
Your data lives only on this phone. Export a backup file in Settings.
You are avoiding this for \"%1$s\". Only you decide. Yes marks today as missed.
Reminders for goals that are due, with Done and I missed it buttons.
Your time slot is open now.
No notifications for this goal. It is still tracked and can still be missed.
Starts when the time slot opens and stops when the goal is done, missed, or the day ends.
This goal has no time slot, so the first reminder comes at this time.
Shows over the lock screen when Android allows it. Otherwise it arrives as a pop-up with sound.
I will be reminded every %1$d minutes
Lets Skriti see which app is in front, by package name only, so it can show a block screen over an app you chose. It never reads what is on your screen.
A quiet notification that keeps the blocker running.
Tells you when blocking has stopped working.
Watching for the apps you chose to block.
Android turned off Skriti\'s blocker, so nothing is being blocked. Tap to open Skriti, then switch it on again under Accessibility.
A hidden screen for trying out how apps can be blocked. Only in test builds.
A proof of concept with one test app and no goals. It finds out which way of showing a block works on this phone. Nothing here is saved to your goals.

Android may grey out the switch for an app you installed from a file. If so, open the app info, tap the three dots at the top right and choose \"Allow restricted settings\". If you do not see that menu item, go on to step 2.
Open Accessibility settings, find Skriti under downloaded or installed apps, and switch it on. Android asks you to confirm.
Display over other apps lets the service open a block screen. The battery setting asks Android not to stop the blocker while the phone sits idle.
Shows a quiet notification while the service runs, so Android is less likely to stop it.
Presses Home and then opens a block screen of this app. Needs Display over other apps.
Android may later show a notice that this service can see which app is open. That is expected: it reads package names only, never the screen.
Package name of the test app
The service starts a screen of this app over the test app.
The service draws the block in an accessibility overlay window. No extra permission.
The service presses Home every time the test app opens. Apps like YouTube then shrink to a floating window and keep playing.
The overlay shows, and after 2.5 seconds Home is pressed.
Block screen, home if it fails
Tries the block screen and presses Home when it did not open.
A block does not stop a video or music playing behind it. This presses pause on whatever is playing when the block appears.
The test is on, but the blocker is switched off in Accessibility settings, so nothing is blocked. Android switches it off when the app is force-stopped. Switch it on again.
Nothing yet. Start the test and open the test app.
%1$s is blocked while the blocking test runs.
Check that reminders can reach you: notifications, exact times, lock-screen alerts and battery settings.
Reminders and blocking need these. You can skip any of them and add it later in Settings.
How reminders reach you right now
Needed to show reminders with their Done and I missed it buttons.
Reminders are set to a quiet level. Allow pop-ups for the Reminders channel so they are hard to miss.
Lets reminders arrive at the exact minute. Without it they can be a few minutes late.
Only for goals with the loud full-screen reminder on. Android may keep this off.
Some phones stop apps in the background. Exempting Skriti from battery optimisation helps reminders arrive. Some brands also have an autostart list to check.
If you force-stop the app from Android settings, Android cancels its alarms until you open it again. This is an Android rule.
Reminders may not reach you: notifications or exact times are off, so they only show inside the app or can be late.
Goals that are still not done at this time count as missed.
How much a goal kept at its minimum counts towards the day\'s percentage. A full goal counts 100%.
Your data stays on this phone. Save a backup file to restore it after a reinstall or on another phone. The spreadsheet file cannot be restored.
The backup has %1$d goals and %2$d recorded days. \"Add to what is here\" keeps your current data and adds the rest. \"Replace everything\" removes what is here first.
Moves the app\'s clock so windows, day ends and week ends can be checked without waiting. Only in test builds.
Uninstalling the app deletes all of its data. Save a backup first if you want to keep your history.
Nothing is due on this day.
Add a goal and it will show up here on the days it is due.
Press and hold the circle to mark a goal as missed.
%1$s, not done. Tap to mark done, hold for more.
%1$s, kept. Tap to undo, hold for more.
%1$s, kept at the minimum. Tap to mark as fully done, hold for more.
%1$s, missed. Tap to mark as kept, hold for more.
You have no goals yet. Add one to start tracking.
Something you do. You mark it done when you have.
Something to stop doing. Mark a day as kept when you stayed away.
It is removed from today and future days. Days you already marked done or missed stay in your history.
Keep the name to 60 characters or fewer.
The end time must be after the start time.
Missed: the day ended and it was not done
Kept %1$d of %2$d days in the last 30
%1$d of those days at the minimum
The time slot ended at %1$s and the extra time has run out.
The day ended and it was not done.
the time slot ends and it is not done
the day ends and it is not done

The time slot ends and it is not done
At %1$s plus %2$d minutes of extra time
The day ends and it is not done
At the day-end time in Settings
Shows an \"I missed it\" button on the goal
Marking it done in the extra time still counts and is noted as late.
This rule needs a time slot.
Reaching the minimum still counts as kept. Below it the goal counts as missed when a rule fires. Counting in minutes adds a timer.
For example: put on shoes and walk 5 minutes
A smaller version of the goal that still counts as kept on a bad day.
Name the unit, for example minutes.
The target must be at least 1.
The minimum must be at least 1.
The minimum cannot be above the target.
Keep the minimum description to 60 characters or fewer.
Emergency unblock: hold a button for 5 seconds
The emergency unblock lifts every block for a while. Block end times keep running. Two uses per day.
These apps can never be blocked, even if a goal lists them. Your phone, messages, contacts, clock, maps and authenticator apps are added for you.
Every goal that blocks an app, and when each block ends. The app stays blocked until the last one ends.
Emergency unblock: blocks are lifted for %1$s
What the block screen says. Up to 160 characters. Empty brings back the default. Tap a chip to insert a value.
Show today\'s attempts on the block screen
A miss sends a notice. Nothing is blocked.
A miss sends a notice and blocks the apps you choose.
As Block apps, plus a full-screen alert and the warning wallpaper.
Message shown when the apps are blocked (optional)
The message can be at most 160 characters.

Recommended. It fails as soon as the days left are fewer than the times still needed.
It is judged only on the last day of the week or month.
Your break is over. This goal counts again from today.
Take a break from this goal while you are away or unwell. It makes no reminders, misses or new blocks, and the days do not count against you.
Take a break from this goal

Rescue day: nothing counts for or against you on this date.

Shows your own wallpaper, and an animated warning when a goal set to Block apps + wallpaper is missed.
When a goal set to Block apps + wallpaper is missed, your home screen shows a warning with the goal, the task you owe and a countdown, then returns to your own wallpaper.
Android does not let apps read your current wallpaper, so pick it once here. Skriti keeps a copy and puts it back when the warning ends.
